label: Ghee residue
note: More of it forms when ghee is made from medium-fat cream than from butter

about.text: The brown solids that settle and are filtered off when ghee is made: heat-denatured milk protein, caramelised milk sugar, minerals, some fat and moisture. It is used for sweets such as candy, chocolate and burfi.

links.name: Janghu et al. 2014, Indian Journal of Dairy Science 67(4): Physicochemical analysis of ghee residue and conversion into confectionary food products

sources.text: The photograph, its author and its licence, from its page.

how.text: It is the solids-not-fat of the cream or butter, coagulated and browned by the heat.
